description:
Build reproducible German corpora under evals/, the same way the English ones rebuild byte for byte. Human side is dewiki-20180920-pages-articles.xml.bz2 from archive.org plus the German rows of sedthh/gutenberg_multilang (MIT). AI side is COLING 2025 GenAI Content Detection Task 1 (Apache-2.0, German rows) plus the German conversations of allenai/WildChat-4.8M. Store sentence and paragraph corpora like the English ones, with a fixed sample size and seed. Record source, license, and row counts in evals/README.md. See docs/research/2026-09-30-german-ai-text-datasets.md.

Acceptance.
1. One command rebuilds every German corpus byte for byte.
2. evals/README.md names each source with license and row count.
3. Large downloads stay out of git, the same as the English corpora.
title: Build the German measurement corpora
